name: Fable Unconstrained
strategy: Defensive risk-premia harvest: long contrarian value/mean-reversion (gold pullback, Brazil carry, UNH, Berkshire, staples) + volatility-risk-premium via SVXY, 32% cash at 4%

positions.thesis: Trimmed 14->10: the driver of the +10% month (rising no-hike odds) reversed at Jackson Hole and gold fell 2% from the $4,696 high; the multi-quarter reversion-to-$5,000 case survives (Treasury long-bond support, UBS target), but a hawkish-Fed dollar is the classic headwind, so I bank part of the run and keep core size.

Trimmed 14->10 by the same rule as 7/30: hawkish-Fed dollar risk (~58% Sept hike odds post-Warsh) is the documented trigger for trim size. The core carry thesis is intact — single-digit P/E, ~8% carry, Selic cutting cycle live at 14% — so the position stays; only the dollar-risk overlay changed.
Unchanged quality-value ballast: the record cash pile now earns MORE if Warsh hikes, and it remains the book's flight-to-quality sink if hawkish repricing cracks the record-high tape.

Unchanged multi-year reversion: Q2 beat, raised FY26 guide, and Medicare Advantage funding tailwind still confirming the sub-$300-to-$420 recovery; an Erste downgrade to Hold and commercial-cost worries are noise against bullish call flow, and rate policy barely touches the thesis.
Unchanged correction hedge: cheap defensive carry that is designed to lag record highs and outperform if the now-live hike risk reverses the melt-up — exactly the scenario Warsh made more probable.

reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-29: Warsh's Jackson Hole speech re-fired the exact trigger this book has traded twice: Sept hike odds jumped ~35%->~58% with two hikes priced by March. Rule-consistency: I trimmed EWZ on 7/30 at ~60% hike odds and restored it on 8/15 when odds collapsed — the condition has returned, so EWZ goes back to trim size (14->10) against renewed dollar strength, while the Selic-carry core thesis keeps it in the book. GLD's stated driver — rising no-hike odds — reversed on Friday and gold fell 2% from a $4,696 three-month high, so I bank part of the extended run (14->10); holding a full-size position after the overshoot driver flips is the wrong side of mean reversion. SVXY is cut entirely: its own sizing logic said 'hike odds fell' and 'contango intact' justified 5% — hike odds now near 60% into a September FOMC with VIX at a compressed 14.35 means the harvested premium is thin and the spike convexity against me is maximal; the VRP trade returns when vol is fatter or the hike is resolved. BRK-B, UNH, and XLP are untouched — the defensive core is worth more, not less, in a hawkish regime — and cash rises to 44% at 4% APY, which gets a raise if the Fed actually hikes. Net: de-risk the three legs whose specific stated conditions reversed, change nothing else.
novelty: Zero symbol overlap with my Round-2 momentum book: this book now expresses the hawkish-Warsh shift through defensive value, carry trims, and a 44% cash yield position rather than through momentum leaders and crypto.
